text:
Leah (Growth): Heads-up: need a compact promo timeline for the Practical Inference Economics webinar. Launch post, paid ads, and reminder cadence.
Carlos - Events: Timeline: 2w out announce, 1w reminder, 2d last push, 1h pre-reminder. Do we want a soft RSVP goal (e.g., 1.2k signups)?
Leah (Growth): Soft goal = 1200. KPI: live attendees 20% of signups. Target ICP: infra engineers + product managers at mid-market SaaS.
Emma (Content): I'll write a short abstract + 3 caption variants (engineer, product, exec). Draft abstract:
"Cut inference cost without compromising UX. Join Redwood Inference to see a practical framework for balancing latency, quality, and spend — plus customer case studies and a live demo of low-cost serving patterns."
Priya (Infra): For demo I want to show 3 knobs: batching, KV cache, and small-quant model fallback. Will prep a live run and a 2-min recorded fallback.
Devon - Customer: I'll confirm if Mateo wants to join panel (can share a short case note). He can speak to 30% token cost reduction after moving to dedicated capacity.
event-bot: Reminder: request speaker bios + slides due in 72 hours. Task created #78902.
Carlos - Events: AV checklist: mic test, screen-share test, demo network test, recording enabled, fallback video cued. Sam - Ops will monitor chat and escalate.
Sam - Ops: I'll own chat watcher + clip capture. Also will stage a sandbox link for demo attendees: `sandbox.redwood.ai/demo-econ`.
Leah (Growth): Promo assets needed: 1 hero image (1200x628), 1 benchmark chart (png + svg), 3 tweet images (1200x675). Emma + Priya to coordinate with eng-ml for chart data.
Emma (Content): I'll draft copy for LinkedIn, Twitter, and a short press blurb. Also a 30-45s teaser script for IG/Twitter video.
Priya (Infra): For the benchmark chart, propose showing cost/token for three configs (hosted default, quantized + batching, dedicated pool). I'll export numbers and share csv.
Carlos - Events: Run-of-show suggestion (60m):
```
00:00 - 00:05  Host intro + sponsor slide
00:05 - 00:25  Framework talk (Leah)
00:25 - 00:35  Live demo (Priya)
00:35 - 00:50  Customer panel (Devon moderates)
00:50 - 00:60  Live Q&A + CTAs
```
Leah (Growth): CTAs: primary = claim eval credits, secondary = download cost-playbook. Use UTM `utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference_econ_2025&utm_medium=email`.
Devon - Customer: Panel prep question: will we share anonymized numbers or exact figures? Mateo is comfortable with percentages but not raw dollar amounts.
Priya (Infra): Percentages + relative cost factors fine. I'll label axes as % reduction vs baseline.
Emma (Content): Draft email cadence: announce (2w), reminder1 (1w), reminder2 (2d), last-call (1h). Include variant subject lines for A/B test.
Carlos - Events: Rehearsals: tech check 48h before, dress 3h before. Please upload final slides 72h before. We need an emergency pre-recorded demo in case of network issues.
Leah (Growth): Who will run the recording? Priya + Sam?
Sam - Ops: I'll record `demo-fallback-v1.mp4` and host on S3 + link in ops doc. Will also prepare console logs snippet to paste in chat if demo dies.
event-bot: Action assigned: Upload slides (task #78903) to drive. Due 72h before event.
Emma (Content): I'll also prepare 5 tweet-sized blurbs and 3 pull-quotes for the event page.
Leah (Growth): Good. Final ask: please drop speaker bios (one-liners) in this thread when confirmed. I'll finalize the event page copy once bios + hero image land.
Carlos - Events: noted. Will follow up on studio booking and send calendar invites after bios confirmed.
Devon - Customer: Mateo confirmed tentative availability for the panel. I'll post a short bio later today.
Leah (Growth): Great. If no objections, locking timeline and CTAs. Flag anything blocking. :pray:
Priya (Infra): No blockers from infra side.
Emma (Content): No blockers.
Sam - Ops: All good.
Carlos - Events: locking and proceeding.
Leah (Growth): Thanks team 44d I'll post the promo calendar here once I schedule the campaign.
event-bot: Thread closed for planning; reopen if changes needed.
